verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an LLM inference provider, since on-prem deployment is conceivable for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents Groq as a hosted cloud API reached through api.groq.com, with service tiers, batch processing and LoRA uploads all running on Groq's infrastructure. Nothing in the pack shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core product.
